fusions.name: Crushing Hug
fusions.desc: Locks both arms round the target and squeezes for 30 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Baited Too Long
fusions.desc: Swipes through a wide arc 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Fat for the Winter
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Shag Beneath Steel
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your physical resistance rises by 6%.
